name: YouMakeup VQA Challenge
description: The goal of the YouMakeup VQA Challenge 2020 is to provide a common benchmark for fine-grained action understanding in domain-specific videos e.g. makeup instructional videos. We propose two novel question-answering tasks to evaluate models' fine-grained action understanding abilities. The first task is \textbf{Facial Image Ordering}, which aims to understand visual effects of different actions expressed in natural language to the facial object. The second task is \textbf{Step Ordering}, which aims to measure cross-modal semantic alignments between untrimmed videos and multi-sentence texts. In this paper, we present the challenge guidelines, the dataset used, and performances of baseline models on the two proposed tasks. The baseline codes and models are released at \url{https://github.com/AIM3-RUC/YouMakeup_Baseline}.
domain: video understanding / action understanding (makeup instructional videos)
evaluation_method: ordering accuracy and ranking correlation metrics (e.g., top-1 accuracy for ordering tasks, Kendall's Tau for step ordering)
general_score_metric: ordering accuracy (and ranking correlation such as Kendall's Tau)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific VQA challenge for makeup instructional videos with limited adoption outside multimedia/action-understanding researchers.
notes: Domain-specific (makeup videos), relatively small / specialized dataset; multimodal alignment required; potential annotation noise and dataset bias from online instructional videos.
